# PDF.js 5.4.296

Source: npm package pdfjs-dist@5.4.296, https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The renderer, matching worker, CMaps, standard fonts and image-decoding WASM
assets are bundled locally so that viewing a user's PDF does not need a CDN.
The PDF file is read in the browser and is not uploaded to a server.

See LICENSE (Apache-2.0) and the license files in the asset directories.
